A simple place to begin

What do Christians mean by the good news?

Christians believe God made people to know Him. Sin harms that relationship and brings real separation. The good news is that Jesus died and rose again to bring forgiveness and new life. Christians receive this as a gift by trusting Him—not by earning it through good behavior.

Read more: Romans 3:23 · Romans 5:8 · Romans 10:9–10

Scripture for the moment

Prayer & Scripture

Choose a topic, read the passage, and use the suggested words as a starting point for your own prayer.

Send a private prayer requestVisit the Prayer Wall

Protection & courage

Trusting God for safety

Psalm 91 is a song of trust in God’s shelter and care. It encourages confidence in God; it is not a promise that believers will never face harm.

Read: Psalm 91 · Psalm 121

Suggested prayer

God, be my refuge today. Give me courage, guide my steps, and help me trust Your care through what lies ahead.

Anxiety & peace

Bringing worries to God

Psalm 23 pictures the Lord as a shepherd who stays near. Philippians 4:6–7 encourages prayer and trust amid worry.

Read: Psalm 23 · Philippians 4:6–7

Suggested prayer

Father, You know what is troubling me. Help me bring each concern to You, receive Your peace, and take the next step with You.

Guidance & wisdom

Asking for direction

These passages invite us to seek God’s ways and ask Him for wisdom as we make decisions.

Read: Psalm 25:4–5 · James 1:5

Suggested prayer

Lord, show me Your way. Give me wisdom to choose what is good, patience to listen, and courage to follow through.

Healing & strength

Seeking help in suffering

The Bible makes room for cries of pain, prayer for healing, and care from others. We can ask boldly while entrusting the outcome to God.

Read: Psalm 6 · James 5:13–16

Suggested prayer

God, bring healing and strength. Comfort everyone affected, guide those who are helping, and stay near through each part of this journey.

Grief & loneliness

When your heart is heavy

The Psalms show that sorrow can be brought honestly to God. Psalm 34 speaks of God’s nearness to the brokenhearted.

Read: Psalm 34 · Psalm 42

Suggested prayer

Lord, I feel the weight of this loss. Stay close to me, help me receive support, and give me strength for today.

Gratitude & praise

Giving thanks

Psalm 100 calls God’s people to thanksgiving; Psalm 103 remembers His compassion and steadfast love.

Read: Psalm 100 · Psalm 103

Suggested prayer

God, thank You for Your goodness and for the gifts I often overlook. Help me remember Your faithfulness and share that goodness with others.

Confession & mercy

Returning to God

Psalm 51 gives words of confession and a plea for a renewed heart; Psalm 32 describes the relief of receiving forgiveness.

Read: Psalm 51 · Psalm 32

Suggested prayer

Merciful God, I confess where I have gone wrong. Forgive me, renew my heart, and help me make things right where I can.

Family & blessing

Praying for loved ones

Psalm 127 reflects on family and dependence on God. Numbers 6:24–26 is a blessing asking the Lord to keep and give peace.

Read: Psalm 127 · Numbers 6:24–26

Suggested prayer

Lord, watch over the people I love. Give them wisdom, kindness, and peace, and help our family grow in love for You and one another.

Action · Worship · Encourage

Spreading Christ, one mission at a time.

AWE Missions is a family-led mobile missionary effort that shares the love of Jesus through community and practical service. We hope to meet needs with food, clothing, shelter connections, Bibles, and encouragement.

Privacy & usage tracking

We use a random ID stored in this browser to count app visits, resource opens, game starts, and completions. We store only the app, event, and date. We do not collect names, location, prayer requests, comments, or Bible notes. Each app has a separate ID. Clearing browser storage may make a returning visitor appear new. Turning analytics off stops future tracking; reset removes this app’s stored ID and its event records.
